name: Tunnelsnake
author: Leandro Ciric
description: OpenVPN 3 tunnel control in the Omarchy bar: connect, disconnect, and watch every running session at a glance.

barWidget.description: Connect and disconnect OpenVPN 3 tunnels, and see which sessions are running.

schema.label: VPN profile
schema.description: The .ovpn file the switch connects to. Leave empty to use the first profile found in the profiles folder.

schema.label: Profiles folder
schema.description: Folder scanned for .ovpn files. Imported openvpn3 configurations are always listed as well.

schema.label: Tunnel DNS server
schema.description: Optional. Pinned on the tun device with resolvectl right after connecting.

schema.label: Tunnel search domains
schema.description: Optional, space separated. Prefix with ~ to route only that domain through the tunnel, e.g. ~internal.example.com.
